sources.entry: Live Translator - Real-time on-screen translation of any system audio (YouTube, podcasts, meetings) using OpenAI or Gemini. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/umutcetinkaya/live-translator) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]
Live Translator - Real-time on-screen translation of any system audio (YouTube, podcasts, meetings) using OpenAI or Google Gemini.

summary.one_liner: A macOS menu bar app that captures whatever audio the Mac is playing, transcribes it, and shows a live translation in a floating on-screen panel.
summary.what_it_does: Live Translator captures system audio through ScreenCaptureKit, with no audio drivers needed, and transcribes it with SFSpeechRecognizer. Every few seconds it sends a sliding window of the transcript to a chosen AI provider (OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Anthropic Claude), which appends or refines a running translation. The translation appears in a dark, draggable, always-on-top WebKit overlay, with new text highlighted. It supports 11 source languages and 12 target languages, and text-to-speech can read translations aloud using Piper offline or OpenAI/Gemini voices. Speech recognition runs on-device by default; an optional realtime mode streams audio to OpenAI's Realtime Translation model for lower latency.
use_cases: Translate a foreign-language YouTube video live
Follow a non-native podcast in real time
Understand a meeting conducted in another language
Read live translations of movies or streams
Hear translated speech read aloud with TTS
how_to_run: make install  # create venv and install dependencies
make models  # download TTS voice models (~580MB)
notable: Live document model: the AI sees the sliding window and preserves prior translation instead of translating word by word
On-device speech recognition by default, so audio never leaves the Mac; only text goes to the provider
No audio drivers needed; uses ScreenCaptureKit system audio capture
Automatic filtering of the app's own TTS output from capture to avoid feedback loops
Watchdog auto-recovers stuck speech recognition within 10 seconds
caveats: Requires macOS 13 (Ventura) or later and an API key from OpenAI, Gemini, or Anthropic
Realtime mode sends audio to the provider, and only OpenAI supports it; Claude is text-translation only
OpenAI and Gemini TTS voices cost money; Piper is free but has a robotic voice
Installing from source requires downloading about 580MB of TTS models
